profile.name: Md. Roton Ahmed
profile.headline: Building AI for people, from research to reality.
profile.summary: I work at the intersection of AI research and backend engineering—building accessible Bengali interfaces, multimodal data pipelines and machine learning systems with real-world purpose.
profile.about:
I am a CSE graduate from Pabna University of Science and Technology, with my final result currently pending. I want to use AI, natural language processing and deep learning to solve problems that matter to people.

My work connects research with implementation: collecting handwriting signals, studying bilingual biometrics, designing webcam-based Bengali eye typing and serving ML models through usable APIs. I have contributed to nine published international conference papers, including one as first author.

I enjoy the whole process—from framing a question and collecting data to evaluating a model and building the software around it. I am looking for opportunities where careful research and practical engineering can create social impact.

data.title: NetroLekha: Bengali eye typing
data.role: System design, implementation and user-study analysis
data.summary: A webcam-based gaze-typing system exploring a lower-cost route to Bengali text entry with speech feedback.
data.problem: Dedicated infrared eye trackers can create a hardware-access barrier. NetroLekha explores webcam-only Bengali communication for people with severe motor impairment.
data.approach:
Built a browser-based gaze interface using WebGazer.js, a five-zone hierarchical dwell-time keyboard and a phonetic Roman-to-Bangla transliteration engine. Added an audio-feedback pipeline with offline-first neural speech and fallback options.

Collected and analyzed a 41-participant, 410-trial corpus to study word completion and navigation errors.
data.outcome:
The CV-reported study recorded 41.7% word-completion accuracy and 33.4% character error rate. Zone-level navigation emerged as the dominant error source (r = 0.62). These findings identify a design limitation rather than establish clinical effectiveness.

A companion Data in Brief data article is submitted; the system manuscript is in preparation for journal submission.
data.tags: Accessible HCI, Bengali, WebGazer.js, JavaScript, User study

data.title: Bilingual handwriting research pipeline
data.role: Funded research assistant; proposal, acquisition software and analysis pipeline
data.summary: A custom Wacom acquisition system and reproducible pipeline for Bengali–English handwriting research.
data.problem: Handwriting research needs synchronized signals, consistent prompts and traceable sample exports. The project supports both online pen dynamics and offline handwriting images.
data.approach:
Designed a Linux data-collection application using Python, Tkinter, Cairo, GTK and evdev for a Wacom Cintiq 22. Captured coordinates, pressure, tilt, hover distance and stroke timing at approximately 150 Hz.

Implemented aligned CSV/image exports, normalized ink images and 90+ kinematic and temporal features in the public collection repository. The thesis studies kinematic–visual fusion for writer identification and participant-level demographic inference.
data.outcome: Won competitive university research funding of BDT 24,000. Produced a reusable data-acquisition and preprocessing codebase. The thesis manuscript is in preparation for journal submission; no unpublished performance claims are presented here.
data.tags: Multimodal learning, Python, Tkinter, Wacom, Feature engineering

data.title: Vision Transformer MRI classifier
data.summary: A four-class MRI image classifier with a FastAPI inference service and Streamlit interface.
data.problem: Model experiments need an interface and a repeatable serving path to make inference inspectable beyond a training notebook.
data.approach: Fine-tuned a ViT image classifier for glioma, meningioma, no-tumor and pituitary classes. Built a FastAPI service that loads local model artifacts once and exposes health and prediction endpoints. A Streamlit client provides image upload, preview and confidence display.
data.outcome: A complete local inference workflow with backend health checks, configurable API URL and documented artifact preparation. This is an educational research prototype; it does not establish clinical diagnostic validity.

data.title: Text-classification inference API
data.role: Model pipeline packaging and REST API development
data.summary: A FastAPI service wrapping a scikit-learn TF-IDF and Naive Bayes text-classification pipeline.
data.problem: Text preprocessing and model inference need to behave consistently when a model moves from a notebook into a backend service.
data.approach: Packaged vectorization and classification in a scikit-learn pipeline and serialized the artifact for reuse. Built health and prediction endpoints, returning a label and confidence through a REST interface.
data.outcome: A documented model-serving example that connects a reusable scikit-learn pipeline to a FastAPI interface. The emphasis is on consistent preprocessing, validation and an inspectable prediction response.

data.title: House price prediction system
data.role: Data preparation, model comparison and application development
data.summary: An end-to-end regression project comparing seven models and exposing the selected model through Gradio.
data.problem: A tabular prediction project needs consistent cleaning, feature handling and model selection before a usable interface.
data.approach: Prepared data, handled missing values and feature scaling, engineered features and compared seven regression models using GridSearchCV. Serialized the selected model and built an interactive Gradio application.
data.outcome: A reproducible training-to-interface workflow with publicly available source code. Performance claims depend on the evaluation protocol and are not inferred from the deployment interface.

data.title: Customer segmentation dashboard
data.summary: An interactive K-Means dashboard with cluster profiling, elbow analysis and CSV export.
data.problem: Clustering output is more useful when people can inspect the features, cluster sizes and profiles behind each assignment.
data.approach: Implemented standardized customer features, an adjustable K-Means workflow and elbow-method analysis. Built a Streamlit dashboard with centroid visualization, segment summaries and downloadable cluster assignments.
data.outcome: An interactive Streamlit tool for exploring customer segments, checking cluster profiles and exporting assignments for further analysis.

data.title: Fake news classification pipeline
data.role: NLP preprocessing, model comparison and Gradio interface
data.summary: A text-classification project connecting exploratory analysis, TF-IDF features and an interactive prediction interface.
data.problem: News classification experiments need transparent preprocessing and evaluation before their predictions can be interpreted.
data.approach: Explored the text dataset, normalized text and used TF-IDF representations. Compared Naive Bayes and Logistic Regression, serialized the selected model and built a Gradio interface.
data.outcome: A public NLP pipeline with training notebooks and an inference application. Dataset performance does not establish that the system can reliably judge new real-world claims.

data.title: Stock analysis & forecasting dashboard
data.role: Time-series preparation and interactive dashboard development
data.summary: A Streamlit dashboard for historical market data, technical indicators and Prophet forecasts.
data.problem: Time-series patterns are easier to inspect when historical context, uncertainty and indicators are visible together.
data.approach: Built candlestick charts and RSI, MACD and Bollinger Band features using yfinance and Plotly. Integrated Prophet forecasts, confidence intervals and CSV downloads.
data.outcome: A documented interactive forecasting project. Its forecasts are exploratory model outputs, with no claim of reliable investment returns.

data.title: Autonomous irrigation robot
data.summary: A grant-supported line-following robot combining plant irrigation, obstacle sensing and soil-moisture feedback.
data.problem: Automating repeated watering along a predefined route requires coordinating navigation, sensing and actuation.
data.approach: Co-proposed and helped build a microcontroller-based robot combining IR line detection, ultrasonic obstacle sensing and moisture-triggered watering.
data.outcome: Co-recipient of a BDT 22,500 university Innovative Project Grant. The work led to a published QPAIN 2025 IEEE conference paper with a verified DOI.

An inference service also needs consistent preprocessing, validation, health checks and a usable interface.

## A small FastAPI example

```python

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/health")
def health():

```
